channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Senate committee approves abstinence-based sex ed bill
item.description: An Alabama Senate committee advanced legislation Thursday requiring public schools to exclusively teach sexual risk avoidance, effectively rebranding abstinence-only sex education.

item.title: L. Keith Granger recognized with Alabama Healthcare Hall of Fame induction
item.description: The Alabama Hospital Association honored longtime leader L. Keith Granger for his decades of dedication to hospital quality and patient safety.

item.title: Gov. Ivey establishes board to oversee emerging technology
item.description: Governor Kay Ivey established a new board Thursday to oversee the secure and ethical deployment of artificial intelligence across Alabama's executive branch agencies.

item.title: HB161 advances amid debate over child online safety enforcement
item.description: Alabama lawmakers advanced legislation requiring age verification for app downloads, drawing support from tech giants despite concerns over practical enforcement and constitutional challenges.

item.title: House committee advances bill to reshape Archives board
item.description: Lawmakers advanced legislation to grant political leaders control over board appointments, sparking concerns about the removal of two Black members.

item.title: Alabama governor signs law allowing death penalty for child predators
item.description: The Child Predator Death Penalty Act, a major priority for conservative leaders, has the potential to shift broader legal precedents regarding executions.

item.title: House passes bill to notify parents when their child receives a traffic citation
item.description: State representatives authorized a $100,000 electronic system Thursday for legal guardians to opt into notifications for a minor's traffic infractions.

item.title: House pulls PSC appointment bill amid Senate uncertainty
item.description: The House of Representatives pulled a bill to appoint PSC members amid uncertain Senate support and intensified constituent concerns

item.title: Opinion | How not to teach sex ed
item.description: Alabama keeps trying abstinence-only sex ed. It has failed spectacularly. So we're going to try it more.

item.title: Opinion | HB169 and the fight over who controls Alabama’s memory
item.description: A restructuring bill raises urgent questions about political power, historical integrity and who decides Alabama’s official story.
